title: Presidential UFO briefings, Nixon to Bush, but not Clinton

tellings.quote: Nixon, Carter, Reagan, Bush all seem to have received briefings. The moment you get to Clinton, I think it's pretty demonstrable he didn't.

plain: US presidents Nixon, Carter, Reagan and Bush all seem to have been briefed on UFOs, but Bill Clinton was not, according to a researcher named Jason Simosa. Simosa tells Michels it is "pretty demonstrable" that Clinton never got such a briefing, covering roughly 1969 to 1993, though he names no source. If true, it would mean the secret was kept from at least one sitting president.
